description:
Resolve OSS dependency names to canonical package, repository, or docs targets. Use known canonical targets directly. Narrow unclear names with known registry/context, never popularity alone. Continue only from a non-ambiguous EXACT or HIGH best with CLEAR or NOT_APPLICABLE malicious-content status. Other or missing statuses are non-actionable. MEDIUM and LOW require narrowing or an explicit choice; never auto-select an ambiguous result. CLEAR is not a vulnerability-free claim. A selected `site:` is docs-only: search with source: "docs" and reuse returned read locators. Inputs leave this machine; open-source targets only.

Load the GitHits guide once per session first (`quick_start` or the `githits-mcp` skill).

format.description: Omit for text. Use json only when code consumes raw fields or text lacks a required field.

intent_hints.description: Ranking hints only; do not expand retrieval. Empty, blank and duplicate hints are ignored. Never include credentials, personal data, private code, or proprietary content.

limit.description: Optional integer candidate limit from 1 through 20.

name.description: Human-friendly package, repository, or docs-site name, including lp:PROJECT defaults; not an already canonical target.

preferred_kind.description: package, repository, or site; empty means no preference.

query.description: Ranking context only; does not expand retrieval. Never include credentials, personal data, private code, or proprietary content.

registries.description: Optional registry filter that constrains package candidates only; repository and site candidates remain eligible. Accepted registries: npm, pypi, hex, crates, nuget, maven, zig, vcpkg, packagist, rubygems, go, swift, pub. An empty list deliberately means no filter.

verbose.description: When true, text output includes coarse lexical name-similarity evidence. Default false. JSON always includes available numeric similarity.

name: resolve_target
